title: Max Number of K-Sum Pairs
description: Find the maximum number of operations that can be performed on an array where each operation chooses two numbers that sum up to k and removes them.

steps.note: Sort the array to enable two-pointer approach.
Initialize pointers i at start and j at end.
Calculate sum of nums[0] (1) and nums[3] (4).
Sum is 5 (target), increment count and move pointers.
Calculate sum of nums[1] (2) and nums[2] (3).
Sum is 5 (target), increment count and move pointers.
Loop terminates as i is no longer less than j.
